title: The Body as World Model: Head, Heart, Hand, and Foot
grammar: Embodied Cognition and Somatic Idioms in Hungarian
goal: I can explain idioms with fej, szív, kéz and láb, such as fejét töri and szívére vesz.
I can say that cognitive linguists link concepts to bodily experience.
I can use szem előtt tart and kézbe vesz in a formal sentence.
